messages:
Priya Rao: Heads up — AWS marketplace bill came back with ~7k in usage tagged to an orphan subscription id (no linked account in our mapping). Looks like those tokens didn't map to any reseller/customer so charges are floating.
Alex Kim: ugh. can you paste the invoice lines or export snippet?
Priya Rao: pasted below. invoice shows product_code, subscription_id, usage_amount, buyer_account_id (empty)
```
product_code,subscription_id,usage_amount,buyer_account_id
ML-INFERENCE-STD,sub-0a9f3c,7123,
```
Jules Martin: buyer_account_id blank — that's the problem. Did the onboarding call have a different customer id? sometimes marketplace sends raw subscription then we map later via purchase_email.
Priya Rao: we checked purchase_email in our ingestion logs — none for this subscription. ingestion pipeline logged: `marketplace_ingest: WARN missing_buyer_id sub-0a9f3c` at 2026-03-19T02:03:11Z
Ben (finance): how much is the attached USD line on the invoice? the 7k is gross or after reseller cut?
Priya Rao: gross charge on the invoice is $7,123. After channel margins it's $4,298 to us. AWS billed us for full amount.
Alex Kim: do we have precedent? iirc last q we had one orphan subscription that AWS retro-allocated after support ticket. took ~2 weeks.
Jules Martin: ok immediate ask: open partner support case with AWS marketplace. priority: they either (A) map subscription to buyer_account_id on their side and reissue invoice, or (B) reclassify so we can issue an internal credit to the affected reseller. we should also flag for legal if this delays revenue recognition.
Priya Rao: created AWS case 1234567890 — note: partner support asked for proof of purchase metadata. i attached ingestion logs and the raw payload. ticket link: https://aws.amazon.com/support/cases/1234567890
invoicing-bot: Automated note: invoice 2026-03-18 #AWM-9987 received and queued for reconciliation.
Ben (finance): until AWS confirms, do NOT pay that portion to the reseller. we need finance leadership signoff to hold payment >$5k. cc @CFO
Alex Kim: CFO flagged. @Ben (finance) can you confirm GL impact? do we book a temporary suspense liability or a receivable?
Ben (finance): recommend suspense liability GL 2205 pending allocation. will post reversing entry when resolved.
Jules Martin: also FYI — might need to issue a manual credit to the reseller in case AWS cannot reclass. can we get approval now to grant a one-time manual credit up to $5k? anything above needs VP signoff.
Ben (finance): approved up to $5k. >$5k requires VP Finance approval. this one is >$5k so we need explicit VP signoff.
Priya Rao: noted. i'll keep AWS ticket updated and escalate if no response in 48h. i'll also open a short JIRA so eng can add extra telemetry to marketplace ingestion (capture purchase_email earlier).
Alex Kim: tagging eng-ops to ensure the ingest captures buyer metadata. small snippet to add to pipeline alerting:
```
if missing(buyer_account_id): emit alert:marketplace.orphan_sub
```
Priya Rao: action items: 1) Priya follow AWS case + escalate in 48h (owner: Priya) 2) Ben hold reseller payment and post suspense GL (owner: Ben) 3) Jules open JIRA for ingestion telemetry (owner: Jules) 4) Alex notify eng-ops to add alert (owner: Alex). timeline: aim to close in 2 weeks.
Ben (finance): acknowledged. i'll loop in VP Finance once AWS case updates.
Jules Martin: thanks — will track in JIRA and ping again tomorrow.
Priya Rao: thanks all. I'll post updates here as AWS responds. :thumbsup:
